1948     def _refresh_model_locked(self, selection):
1949         """Replace an idle bridge while retaining its native session and queued work."""
1950         import model_policy
1951         if self.busy:
1952             return False
1953         current = self.model_selection or {}
1954         if selection.get("family") != self.cli:
1955             raise ValueError("A model refresh must retain the current provider family.")
1956         if all(current.get(key) == selection.get(key) for key in ("family", "model", "effort")):
1957             return True
1958 
1959         stored = self.session_id
1960         if not isinstance(stored, str) or not stored.strip():
1961             raise ValueError("Model refresh requires the existing native session ID.")
1962         if self.cli == "chatgpt":
1963             from uuid import UUID
1964             try:
1965                 UUID(stored)
1966             except (ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
1967                 raise ValueError("Model refresh requires a valid Codex thread UUID.") from exc
1968         model_policy.validate_policy(selection.get("requested_policy"))
1969         model_policy.launch_args(selection)
1970         _, target = self._desired_policy()
1971         if target != self.cli:
1972             raise ValueError("Provider family changed before the idle model refresh.")
1973         if not _update_state(self.skey(), {
1974                 "cli": self.cli, "model_policy": self.model_selection,
1975                 "policy_override": self.policy_override, "session_id": stored,
1976                 "retain_native_on_resume_failure": True}):
1977             raise RuntimeError("Could not persist the native session before model refresh.")
1978         self._journal_routing(
1979             action="model_refresh",
1980             message="Refreshing the next turn's model and effort while retaining its native session.",
1981             family=self.cli, session_id=stored,
1982             previous_model=current.get("model"), previous_effort=current.get("effort"),
1983             requested_model=selection.get("model"), requested_effort=selection.get("effort"))
1984 
1985         queued = list(self.queue)
1986         old_proc = self.proc
1987         self.proc = None  # A retiring reader must not mark the replacement broken.
1988         if old_proc is not None:
1989             self._kill_tree(old_proc)
1990         try:
1991             ok, note = self._wake_locked(
1992                 fresh=False, seed=None, send_initial=False,
1993                 expected_selection=selection, expected_session_id=stored)
1994         finally:
1995             self.queue[:] = queued
1996         if not ok:
1997             # Restore only the idle transport, without submitting a model turn.
1998             # The next actual send must still resolve latest/highest policy.
1999             restored, restore_note = self._wake_locked(
2000                 fresh=False, seed=None, send_initial=False,
2001                 expected_selection=current, expected_session_id=stored)
2002             self.queue[:] = queued
2003             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
2004                         "Previous idle transport restored; request retained." if restored else
2005                         "Native session retained; transport recovery remains unavailable: " + str(restore_note)})
2006             raise RuntimeError("Idle model refresh failed: " + str(note))
2007         if self.cli != selection.get("family") or self.session_id != stored:
2008             replacement = self.proc
2009             self.proc = None
2010             if replacement is not None:
2011                 self._kill_tree(replacement)
2012             self.busy = False
2013             raise RuntimeError("Idle model refresh did not retain the native session.")
2014         return True
2015 
2016     def _send_locked(self, text, *, origin=None):
2017         """Caller holds self._lock. Returns True iff the write reached stdin.
2018 
2019         ``origin`` (Wave 1.2): "human" for John's words, "control" for engine
2020         prompts. Explicit, never inferred from a leading "(" — the resume
2021         prefix starts with one and must still be treated as his message.
2022         """
2023         from steward_cockpit import maintenance
2024         if maintenance.is_active():
2025             # Wave 1.6: nothing new is written to a steward behind the barrier.
2026             # Human words are queued by say(); controls are simply not sent.
2027             if time.time() - getattr(self, "_maintenance_noted_at", 0.0) > 60:
2028                 self._maintenance_noted_at = time.time()
2029                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "maintenance in progress - nothing new is sent to the steward until activation"})
2030             return False
2031         human_text = text  # the durability identity: his words, never the wrapper
2032         if origin == "human" and self._resume_prefix:
2033             text = (self._resume_prefix
2034                     + (JOIN_QUIET if self._resume_prefix.startswith(RESUME_QUIET) else JOIN_PICKUP) + text)
2035             self._resume_prefix = None
2036         if not (self.fake or os.environ.get("STEWARD_COCKPIT_FAKE")):
2037             try:
2038                 settings, target = self._desired_policy()
2039             except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
2040                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Model settings unavailable; message not sent: " + str(exc)})
2041                 return False
2042             if target != self.cli:
2043                 if self.busy:
2044                     self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
2045                                 "Provider refresh deferred until the current turn finishes; message not sent."})
2046                     return False
2047                 return self._rollover_locked(target, settings, text)
2048             try:
2049                 target, selection = self._current_selection(settings, target)
2050                 if target != self.cli:
2051                     if self.busy:
2052                         self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
2053                                     "Provider refresh deferred until the current turn finishes; message not sent."})
2054                         return False
2055                     return self._rollover_locked(target, settings, text)
2056                 current = self.model_selection or {}
2057                 changed = any(current.get(key) != selection.get(key)
2058                               for key in ("family", "model", "effort"))
2059                 if changed:
2060                     if self.busy:
2061                         self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
2062                                     "Model refresh deferred until the current turn finishes; message not sent."})
2063                         return False
2064                     if not self._refresh_model_locked(selection):
2065                         return False
2066             except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
2067                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
2068                             "Model refresh unavailable; message not sent: " + str(exc)})
2069                 return False
2070         proc = self.proc
2071         msg = {"type": "user",
2072                "message": {"role": "user",
2073                            "content": [{"type": "text", "text": text}]}}
2074         if self._bridge_system_prompt:
2075             msg["system_prompt"] = self._bridge_system_prompt
2076         if self.cli in ("chatgpt", "grok"):
2077             msg["standing_rules"] = self._contract()   # every bridge turn is a new process: the rules ride each one
2078             if not self.general and _is_campaign_dir(self.dir) and not _is_cave_dir(self.dir):
2079                 # the Star Chart's remit rides every bridge turn too, resumed or not (Grok code R1 F4)
2080                 msg["standing_rules"] = campaign_mode_remit(self.steward) + self._contract()
2081         # No CLI call under the stdin arbiter. A producer captures its exact
2082         # context through the lifecycle CLI; automatic fallback remains unknown.
2083         refinement_context = None
2084         refinement_producer_id = None
2085         if origin is None:
2086             is_control = text in (TICK, REASSERT) or text.startswith("(")
2087         else:
2088             is_control = origin != "human"
2089         if not self.busy and not is_control and (Path(self.dir) / "roadmap.json").is_file():
2090             from steward_cockpit.producer_handoff import _handoff_id
2091             refinement_producer_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
2092             handoff_id = _handoff_id("conversation", refinement_producer_id)
2093             msg["message"]["content"][0]["text"] += (
2094                 "\n\n(interface bookkeeping, not a new user request) If this campaign is managed "
2095                 "and this turn produces deliverables, capture dispatch context before producing "
2096                 "them, and use producer_handoff id " + handoff_id +
2097                 " with producer_kind conversation. Record explicit output references through "
2098                 "the lifecycle CLI and preserve current cumulative feedback. Leave the handoff "
2099                 "pending for a later inspection of the outputs. Pure inspection and bookkeeping "
2100                 "do not produce a new handoff. Never close "
2101                 "a slice without John's explicit instruction.")
2102         try:
2103             proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + "\n")
2104             proc.stdin.flush()
2105             self._bridge_system_prompt = None
2106             self._last_submitted = text
2107             self._turn_had_tools = False
2108             if not self.busy:
2109                 self._turn_tools = 0
2110                 self._turn_wrote_files = False
2111                 self._turn_output_refs = []
2112                 self._refinement_dispatch_context = refinement_context
2113                 self._refinement_producer_id = refinement_producer_id
2114             self.busy = True
2115             self.turn_started = time.time()
2116             self.turn_text = ""
2117             self._turn_origin = "control" if is_control else "human"
2118             arrivals = getattr(self, "_human_arrivals", None) or []
2119             self._timing = {"arrived": (arrivals.pop(0) if (arrivals and not is_control) else None),
2120                             "started": self.turn_started, "first_word": None, "tools": 0}
2121             if not is_control and not self.general:
2122                 _t = threading.Timer(RECEIPT_AFTER_S, self._early_receipt, args=(self.turn_started,))
2123                 _t.daemon = True
2124                 _t.start()
2125             if not is_control:
2126                 # Wave 1.2: durable until the broker's first native event acks
2127                 # it; reconciled on the next wake if the process dies first.
2128                 # Stored as HIS text (pre-prefix): the resume wrapper already
2129                 # sits in every earlier resume turn of the same thread and
2130                 # would false-match the rollout (Grok R1 F1).
2131                 self._submitted = {"text": human_text[:4000], "at": time.time(),
2132                                    "family": self.cli, "session_id": self.session_id}
2133                 _update_state(self.skey(), {"submitted": self._submitted})
2134             return True
2135         except Exception as e:
2136             self.broken = True
2137             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": f"delivery failed: {e}"})
2138             return False

2140     def _deliver_next_queued_locked(self):
2141         """Deliver the head of the durable queue as John's words (drift line
2142         computed NOW, at delivery — journal 0111). Caller holds self._lock."""
2143         if not self.queue or self.busy:
2144             return False
2145         from steward_cockpit import maintenance
2146         if maintenance.is_active():
2147             return False  # Wave 1.6: held until activation
2148         queued = self.queue[0]
2149         machine = _is_machine_text(queued)
2150         suffix = "" if (self.general or machine or not self.effort_on()) else self._plan_drift_suffix()
2151         if self._send_locked(queued + suffix, origin="control" if machine else "human"):
2152             self.queue.pop(0)
2153         if not self._persist_queue():
2154             self.broken = True
2155             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
2156                         "queue state could not be persisted after "
2157                         "delivery - delivery is uncertain across "
2158                         "a restart"})
2159         return True
2160 
2161     def _reconcile_submitted_locked(self, entry):
2162         """Wave 1.2: a human message written to a broker that died before any
2163         native event acknowledged it is re-queued with a repeat marker. Never
2164         lost; a repeat is marked so the model does not act on it twice. (A
2165         provider-record scan was cut as a second mechanism — Rabbit-Catcher.)"""
2166         sub = entry.get("submitted") if isinstance(entry.get("submitted"), dict) else self._submitted
2167         if not sub or not sub.get("text"):
2168             self._submitted = None
2169             return
2170         marker = ("(possibly a repeat after a restart or interruption; if you already "
2171                   "handled this, say so in one line and do nothing else) ")
2172         if not any(q.endswith(sub["text"]) for q in self.queue):
2173             self.queue.insert(0, marker + sub["text"])
2174         self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "a message submitted before the last interruption was re-queued with a repeat marker"})
2175         self._submitted = None
2176         _update_state(self.skey(), {"submitted": None, "pending_queue": list(self.queue)})
2177 
2178     def _interrupt_turn_locked(self, reason):
2179         """Wave 1.2/1.3: end the running turn. The exec protocol has no
2180         retractable item boundary, so the outcome is recorded as uncertain;
2181         partial writes stay on disk; the queue and the native thread are kept."""
2182         proc = self.proc
2183         if proc is None or proc.poll() is not None or not self.busy:
2184             return {"ok": False, "error": "no running turn"}
2185         origin = getattr(self, "_turn_origin", "human")
2186         self._interrupted = {"at": time.time(), "reason": reason, "origin": origin,
2187                              "text": (self._last_submitted or "")[:300]}
2188         _update_state(self.skey(), {"interrupted": self._interrupted})
2189         self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": f"turn interrupted ({reason}); partial work on disk is kept and the outcome is uncertain until the next turn reconciles it"})
2190         try:
2191             self._journal_routing(action="interrupted", family=self.cli, origin=origin,
2192                                   message=f"turn interrupted: {reason} (origin {origin}); outcome uncertain")
2193         except RuntimeError:
2194             pass
2195         self.proc = None   # the old reader must not touch shared state
2196         self._kill_tree(proc)
2197         self.busy = False
2198         self._hold_queue("turn interrupted")
2199         return {"ok": True}
2200 
2201     def effort_on(self):
2202         """R2: the effort rules ride while an effort is on: John's word ("make this an effort" / "small mode") wins;
2203         else a project cockpit whose plan has an open step is an effort; the Cave and the Star Chart conversations
2204         (one_conversation) and workbench terminals are small by default."""
2205         entry = _read_state_entry(self.skey())
2206         if isinstance(entry.get("effort_mode"), bool):
2207             return entry["effort_mode"]
2208         if self.general or self.one_conversation or self.code_job:
2209             return False
2210         # his word not given: a project cockpit with a step in progress NOW is mid-effort (read fresh, never stored)
2211         try:
2212             rm = json.loads((Path(self.dir) / "roadmap.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
2213             steps = rm.get("roadmap_projection") if isinstance(rm, dict) else None
2214             return any(isinstance(x, dict) and str(x.get("status") or "") in ("active", "in_progress", "running")
2215                        for x in (steps or []))
2216         except Exception:
2217             return False
2218 
2219     def _contract(self):
2220         if self.code_job:
2221             return CODER_CONTRACT
2222         if self.effort_on():
2223             return EFFORT_DUTY + CONTRACT + EFFORT_RULES
2224         return SMALL_DUTY + CONTRACT

2226     def _fire_turn_done(self, result):
2227         cb, self.on_turn_done = self.on_turn_done, None
2228         if cb is None:
2229             return
2230         try:
2231             cb(result)
2232         except Exception:
2233             pass

2235     def _guard_turn(self, block):
2236         """R2/R3: end a small-mode turn that has grown past the step cap (it is handed to a code job), and a turn
2237         that writes into a repository a running code job owns (one writer). True when the turn was ended."""
2238         if self.general or self.code_job or self.fake or not self.busy:
2239             return False
2240         reason, note = "", ""
2241         inp = block.get("input") or {}
2242         paths = [p for p in ([inp.get("file_path")] + list(inp.get("paths") or [])) if isinstance(p, str) and p.strip()]
2243         try:
2244             from steward_cockpit import code_jobs as _cj
2245             owned = _cj.active_repos()
2246         except Exception:
2247             owned = []
2248         hit = []
2249         if owned:
2250             name = block.get("name") or ""
2251             absolute = [p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(self.dir, p) for p in paths]
2252             if name in ("Write", "Edit", "NotebookEdit", "file_change", "apply_patch"):
2253                 hit = [p for p in absolute if any(_cj.inside(p, r) for r in owned)]
2254             elif name in _SHELL_TOOLS:
2255                 # a shell or exec call: a write when it runs inside a busy repository, or names one with a writing verb
2256                 cmd = json.dumps(inp, ensure_ascii=False)[:6000]
2257                 if any(_cj.inside(self.dir, r) for r in owned) and _WRITE_VERBS.search(cmd):
2258                     hit = [self.dir]
2259                 else:
2260                     flat = cmd.replace("\\\\", "/").replace("\\", "/").lower()
2261                     for r in owned:
2262                         rr = str(r).replace("\\", "/").lower().rstrip("/")
2263                         if re.search(re.escape(rr) + r"(?:/|[\"' ]|$)", flat) and _WRITE_VERBS.search(cmd):
2264                             hit = [r]
2265                             break
2266             if hit:
2267                 reason = "one writer: a code job is working on that repository"
2268                 note = ("(interface - not John) Your last turn was ended: it wrote %s while a code job owns that "
2269                         "repository. Do not write there until the job reports; tell John in one line." % hit[0])
2270         # two-lane step 1 (2026-10-05, Grok + Opus): the cap binds in effort mode too - the slowest stewards were the
2271         # ones mid-effort, where it was off; the hand-off names the worker that fits the work, never a generic coder
2272         if not reason and getattr(self, "_turn_origin", "human") == "human" and self._turn_tools > STEP_CAP:
2273             reason = "past %d tool calls: larger than a conversation turn" % STEP_CAP
2274             note = ("(interface - not John) Your last turn was ended after %d tool calls: that is work, not a conversation "
2275                     "turn. Commission it now and come back to John: a code change -> a code job (tools/steward_code_job.py "
2276                     "start, a short brief and a check); research -> researchPrime; a plan -> Crucible; a review -> Gandalf; "
2277                     "a build with a failing gate -> Foreman. Then tell John in one line what you sent off and to whom. Do "
2278                     "not finish the work inline." % self._turn_tools)
2279             self._stopped_mid_turn = True
2280         if not reason:
2281             return False
2282         with self._lock:
2283             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "%s ended its turn (%s)" % (self.steward or "The steward", reason)})
2284             out = self._interrupt_turn_locked(reason)
2285             if isinstance(out, dict) and out.get("ok"):
2286                 self.queue.insert(0, note)
2287                 self._persist_queue()
2288                 self._wake_locked(fresh=False, seed=None)
2289         return True
2290 
2291     def _turn_activity(self):
2292         """What the running turn is on, in its own words: the first sentence the steward spoke this turn, else his
2293         message it is answering."""
2294         said = " ".join(str(getattr(self, "turn_text", "") or "").split())
2295         if said:
2296             first = re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s", said, maxsplit=1)[0]
2297             return first[:110] + ("\u2026" if len(first) > 110 else "")
2298         asked = " ".join(str(getattr(self, "_last_submitted", "") or "").split())
2299         asked = re.sub(r"^\(.*?\)\s*", "", asked)
2300         return ("your message \u201c%s\u201d" % (asked[:80] + ("\u2026" if len(asked) > 80 else ""))) if asked else "a turn"
2301 
2302     def _queued_receipt(self):
2303         started = getattr(self, "turn_started", 0) or 0
2304         since = ""
2305         if started:
2306             mins = int(max(0, time.time() - started) // 60)
2307             since = ", since %s (%d min)" % (time.strftime("%H:%M", time.localtime(started)), mins)
2308         ahead = max(0, len(self.queue) - 1)
2309         nxt = "Your message is next." if not ahead else "Your message is queued after %d other%s." % (ahead, "" if ahead == 1 else "s")
2310         return "%s is on: %s%s. %s" % (self.steward or "The steward", self._turn_activity(), since, nxt)
2311 
2312     def take_now(self):
2313         """R1: his "Take this now" - the running turn ends (outcome uncertain, partial work kept, as a Stop turn) and
2314         the steward wakes on the same thread to answer the queue at once, the sequence the self-started branch of
2315         say() already uses."""
2316         with self._lock:
2317             if not (self.busy and self.queue):
2318                 return {"ok": False, "error": "nothing is waiting behind a running turn"}
2319             out = self._interrupt_turn_locked("John: take this now")
2320             if not (isinstance(out, dict) and out.get("ok")):
2321                 return out
2322             ok, why = self._wake_locked(fresh=False, seed=None)
2323             if not ok:
2324                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "steward could not resume after the interruption: " + str(why) + "; your message is queued"})
2325         try:
2326             self._journal_receipt("turn_interrupted", "John: take this now")
2327         except Exception:
2328             pass
2329         return {"ok": bool(ok), "why": "" if ok else str(why)}
2330 
2331     def interrupt_turn(self, reason="stopped by John"):
2332         with self._lock:
2333             out = self._interrupt_turn_locked(reason)
2334         if isinstance(out, dict) and out.get("ok"):
2335             self._journal_receipt("turn_interrupted", reason)
2336         return out

2338     def _send(self, text):
2339         with self._lock:
2340             return self._send_locked(text)

2342     # ---------- reading ----------
2343     def _read_stdout(self, proc):
2344         for line in proc.stdout:
2345             if proc is not self.proc:
2346                 break   # a newer process owns the engine now - stop feeding it
2347             line = line.strip()
2348             if not line:
2349                 continue
2350             try:
2351                 ev = json.loads(line)
2352             except Exception:
2353                 continue
2354             self._handle(ev, proc)
2355         code = proc.poll()
2356         if proc is not self.proc:
2357             return   # superseded: do not touch shared state (broken/busy/etc)
2358         if code not in (0, None):
2359             self.broken = True
2360         why = getattr(self, "_model_limit", "") or ""
2361         self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": f"steward session ended (exit {code})"
2362                     + (" \u2014 " + why if why else "")})
2363         # the subprocess died unexpectedly - hand back any queued message the
2364         # user was promised, rather than orphaning it (same as stop())
2365         with self._lock:
2366             self.busy = False
2367             self._hold_queue("session ended")
2368             # R3 (Grok code F4): a coder that dies without a result still finishes its job, as a failure
2369             if self.on_turn_done is not None:
2370                 self._fire_turn_done({"text": self.turn_text.strip(), "error": "the coder's session ended (exit %s) without a result" % code})
2371         self._status_update(emit=True)
2372 
2373     def _read_stderr(self, proc):
2374         tail = []
2375         for line in proc.stderr:
2376             tail.append(line.strip())
2377             if len(tail) > 20:
2378                 tail.pop(0)
2379         if (proc is self.proc and tail
2380                 and proc.poll() not in (0, None)):
2381             # Wave 1.3 (Grok R1 F7): this pipe is the bridge's or the native
2382             # CLI's own stderr — it can carry login URLs. Kinds only.
2383             try:
2384                 from steward_cockpit.codex_turn_bridge import classify_stderr
2385                 hint = classify_stderr(tail)
2386                 text = ("engine stderr: " + ", ".join(hint["kinds"][:4])
2387                         + f" ({hint['lines']} lines, content withheld)")
2388             except Exception:
2389                 text = f"engine stderr: {len(tail)} lines (content withheld)"
2390             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": text})
2391 
2392     def _restore_usage_checkpoints(self, stored):
2393         stored = stored if isinstance(stored, dict) else {}
2394         records = stored.get("usage_checkpoints")
2395         records = records if isinstance(records, dict) else {}
2396         self._usage_checkpoints = {}
2397         self._usage_legacy_unknown = bool(stored.get("usage_legacy_unknown", bool(self.tokens or self.turns)))
2398         self._usage_legacy_reported = stored.get("usage_legacy_reported") is True
2399         for invocation_id, record in records.items():
2400             if _usage_uuid(invocation_id) is None or not isinstance(record, dict):
2401                 self._usage_legacy_unknown = True
2402                 continue
2403             valid_credit = type(record.get("credited_tokens")) is int and record["credited_tokens"] >= 0
2404             valid_session = _usage_uuid(record.get("session_id")) is not None
2405             counts = record.get("counts")
2406             valid_counts = counts is None or self._usage_counts(counts) == counts
2407             if counts is not None and valid_counts and valid_credit:
2408                 valid_counts = counts["input_tokens"] + counts["output_tokens"] == record["credited_tokens"]
2409             if counts is None and valid_credit and record["credited_tokens"]:
2410                 valid_counts = False
2411             if not valid_credit or not valid_session or not valid_counts or type(record.get("finalized")) is not bool:
2412                 # Preserve an unusable ID as a quarantine, rather than allow a
2413                 # replay to credit the same invocation over the saved total.
2414                 self._usage_checkpoints[invocation_id] = {"invalid": True, "token_status": "unavailable"}
2415                 self._usage_legacy_unknown = True
2416                 continue
2417             self._usage_checkpoints[invocation_id] = dict(record)
2418         self._usage_source = stored.get("usage_source") or "recorded-turn-results"
2419         self._usage_updated_at = stored.get("usage_updated_at")
2420         self._usage_persistence_error = ("usage-persistence-failed"
2421             if stored.get("usage_persistence_error") == "usage-persistence-failed" else None)
2422         self._usage_attribution_error = ("usage-session-unmatched"
2423             if stored.get("usage_attribution_error") == "usage-session-unmatched" else None)
2424         self._usage_attribution_warned = False
2425 
2426     def _usage_public(self, *, persistence_confirmed=False):
2427         records = tuple(record for record in tuple(self._usage_checkpoints.values()) if not record.get("invalid"))
2428         coverage = {"tracked_invocations": len(records), "reported_invocations": 0,
2429                     "partial_invocations": 0, "unavailable_invocations": 0,
2430                     "finalized_invocations": 0}
2431         verified = self._usage_legacy_reported or self.tokens > 0
2432         persistence_error = None if persistence_confirmed else self._usage_persistence_error
2433         partial = self._usage_legacy_unknown or persistence_error is not None or self._usage_attribution_error is not None
2434         for record in records:
2435             status = record.get("token_status", "unavailable")
2436             if status not in {"reported", "partial", "unavailable"}:
2437                 status = "unavailable"
2438             coverage[status + "_invocations"] += 1
2439             coverage["finalized_invocations"] += record.get("finalized") is True
2440             verified = verified or record.get("counts") is not None
2441             partial = partial or status != "reported" or record.get("finalized") is not True
2442         status = "partial" if verified and partial else "reported" if verified else "unavailable"
2443         return {"token_status": status, "usage_source": self._usage_source,
2444                 "usage_updated_at": self._usage_updated_at,
2445                 "usage_basis": "recorded-turn-results-and-invocation-checkpoints" if records else "recorded-turn-results",
2446                 "checkpoint_coverage": coverage,
2447                 "usage_persistence_error": persistence_error,
2448                 "usage_attribution_error": self._usage_attribution_error,
2449                 "unpriced_inflight": sum(record.get("finalized") is not True for record in records)}
2450 
2451     def _usage_cost_complete(self):
2452         return not self.unpriced_turns and not self._usage_attribution_error and not any(record.get("finalized") is not True for record in tuple(self._usage_checkpoints.values()) if not record.get("invalid"))
2453 
2454     def _usage_cost_status(self):
2455         if self._usage_cost_complete():
2456             return "reported"
2457         return "partial" if self.spend or self.turns > self.unpriced_turns else "unavailable"
2458 
2459     def _usage_payload(self, *, persistence_confirmed=False):
2460         # No lock here: accounting persistence already holds _lock, while
2461         # read-only callers need a snapshot without acquiring it recursively.
2462         return {"spend": round(self.spend, 4) if self._usage_cost_complete() else None,
2463                 "reported_spend": round(self.spend, 4), "cost_complete": self._usage_cost_complete(),
2464                 "completed_cost_complete": not self.unpriced_turns,
2465                 "cost_status": self._usage_cost_status(),
2466                 "unpriced_turns": self.unpriced_turns, "tokens": self.tokens,
2467                 "estimated_spend": round(self.estimated_spend, 4), "estimated_turns": self.estimated_turns,
2468                 "secs": int(self.secs), "turns": self.turns,
2469                 **self._usage_public(persistence_confirmed=persistence_confirmed),
2470                 "usage_legacy_unknown": self._usage_legacy_unknown,
2471                 "usage_legacy_reported": self._usage_legacy_reported,
2472                 "usage_checkpoints": {key: dict(value) for key, value in self._usage_checkpoints.items()}}
2473 
2474     def _persist_usage_locked(self):
2475         """Write the complete aggregate once; retain memory on save failure."""
2476         was_failed = self._usage_persistence_error is not None
2477         try:
2478             saved = _update_state(self.skey(), {"usage": self._usage_payload(persistence_confirmed=True)}) is True
2479         except Exception:
2480             saved = False
2481         self._usage_persistence_error = None if saved else "usage-persistence-failed"
2482         return saved, not saved and not was_failed
2483 
2484     def _warn_usage_persistence(self, warning):
2485         if warning:
2486             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Usage totals could not be saved. The displayed counts are in memory and may be lost on restart."})
2487 
2488     def _usage_identity(self, ev, *, final=False):
2489         key = "usage_invocation_id" if final else "invocation_id"
2490         invocation_id = _usage_uuid(ev.get(key))
2491         session_id = _usage_uuid(ev.get("session_id"))
2492         active_session = _usage_uuid(self.session_id)
2493         if invocation_id is None or session_id is None or session_id != active_session:
2494             return None
2495         record = self._usage_checkpoints.get(invocation_id)
2496         if record is not None and (record.get("invalid") or record.get("session_id") != session_id):
2497             return None
2498         return invocation_id, session_id, record
2499 
2500     def _usage_result_allowed(self, ev):
2501         if "usage_invocation_id" not in ev:
2502             return True  # Legacy providers retain their original accounting.
2503         warning = False
2504         with self._lock:
2505             identity = self._usage_identity(ev, final=True)
2506             # A completed duplicate can be dropped. An owned result whose
2507             # usage identity is missing/foreign must still finish the turn.
2508             allowed = identity is None or not (identity[2] or {}).get("finalized")
2509             if identity is not None and not allowed and self._usage_persistence_error:
2510                 _, warning = self._persist_usage_locked()
2511         self._warn_usage_persistence(warning)
2512         return allowed
2513 
2514     @staticmethod
2515     def _usage_counts(usage, previous=None):
2516         if not isinstance(usage, dict):
2517             return None
2518         previous = previous if isinstance(previous, dict) else {}
2519         counts = {"input_tokens": usage.get("input_tokens"),
2520                   "output_tokens": usage.get("output_tokens"),
2521                   "cached_input_tokens": usage.get("cached_input_tokens", previous.get("cached_input_tokens", 0))}
2522         if any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in counts.values()):
2523             return None
2524         if counts["cached_input_tokens"] > counts["input_tokens"]:
2525             return None
2526         return counts
2527 
2528     def _credit_usage_locked(self, ev, *, final=False):
2529         """Apply a cumulative checkpoint delta; caller owns the Engine lock."""
2530         identity = self._usage_identity(ev, final=final)
2531         if identity is None:
2532             return False
2533         invocation_id, session_id, record = identity
2534         if record is not None and record.get("finalized"):
2535             return False
2536         if record is None:
2537             record = {"session_id": session_id, "credited_tokens": 0, "counts": None,
2538                       "token_status": "unavailable", "finalized": False}
2539             self._usage_checkpoints[invocation_id] = record
2540         previous = record.get("counts")
2541         counts = self._usage_counts(ev.get("usage"), previous)
2542         status = ev.get("token_status", "reported" if counts is not None else "unavailable")
2543         if status not in {"reported", "partial", "unavailable"}:
2544             status = "unavailable"
2545         if record.get("ambiguous"):
2546             status = "partial" if previous is not None else "unavailable"
2547         elif counts is None:
2548             status = "partial" if previous is not None else "unavailable"
2549         elif previous is not None and any(counts[key] < previous[key] for key in counts):
2550             record["ambiguous"] = True
2551             status = "partial"
2552         else:
2553             total = counts["input_tokens"] + counts["output_tokens"]
2554             if total < record["credited_tokens"]:
2555                 record["ambiguous"] = True
2556                 status = "partial"
2557             else:
2558                 self.tokens += total - record["credited_tokens"]
2559                 record["credited_tokens"] = total
2560                 record["counts"] = counts
2561         record["token_status"] = status
2562         record["finalized"] = final
2563         event_source = ev.get("usage_source")
2564         event_source = event_source if isinstance(event_source, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}", event_source) else "provider-result" if final else "provider-checkpoint"
2565         record["source"] = event_source
2566         record["updated_at"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
2567         self._usage_source, self._usage_updated_at = record["source"], record["updated_at"]
2568         return True
2569 
2570     def _record_usage_checkpoint(self, ev):
2571         with self._lock:
2572             if not self._credit_usage_locked(ev):
2573                 return False
2574             saved, warning = self._persist_usage_locked()
2575         self._warn_usage_persistence(warning)
2576         return saved
2577 
2578     def _record_usage_result(self, ev):
2579         # Also support direct callers: a duplicate final may repair durability,
2580         # but cannot reserve or repeat its financial accounting.
2581         if not self._usage_result_allowed(ev):
2582             return False
2583         attribution_warning = False
2584         with self._lock:
2585             tracked = "usage_invocation_id" in ev
2586             refused = tracked and self._usage_identity(ev, final=True) is None
2587             if refused:
2588                 # The process still owns its error/response. Only attribution
2589                 # failed, so retain terminal processing without invented zero
2590                 # usage or charging another session's money and turn counts.
2591                 self._usage_attribution_error = "usage-session-unmatched"
2592                 self._usage_legacy_unknown = True
2593                 attribution_warning = not self._usage_attribution_warned
2594                 self._usage_attribution_warned = True
2595                 self._usage_source = "unattributed-result"
2596                 self._usage_updated_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
2597                 turn_tokens = None
2598             elif tracked:
2599                 if not self._credit_usage_locked(ev, final=True):
2600                     return False
2601                 turn_tokens = self._usage_checkpoints[_usage_uuid(ev["usage_invocation_id"])]["credited_tokens"]
2602             else:
2603                 usage = ev.get("usage")
2604                 usage = usage if isinstance(usage, dict) else {}
2605                 # Codex cached input is a subset. Claude's separate cache
2606                 # read/create counts retain the previous additive behavior.
2607                 turn_tokens = sum(value for key in ("input_tokens", "output_tokens",
2608                     "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens")
2609                     if isinstance((value := usage.get(key)), int)
2610                     and not isinstance(value, bool) and value >= 0)
2611                 self.tokens += turn_tokens
2612                 if self._usage_counts(usage) is None:
2613                     self._usage_legacy_unknown = True
2614                 else:
2615                     self._usage_legacy_reported = True
2616                 self._usage_source = "recorded-turn-results"
2617                 self._usage_updated_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
2618             cost = None if refused else _reported_cost(ev.get("total_cost_usd"))
2619             duration = (_reported_cost(ev.get("duration_ms")) or 0) / 1000
2620             if not refused:
2621                 self.secs += duration
2622                 if cost is None:
2623                     self.unpriced_turns += 1
2624                     if infer_subscription_cli(self.cli, self._usage_source) == "chatgpt":
2625                         counts = (self._usage_checkpoints[_usage_uuid(ev["usage_invocation_id"])].get("counts")
2626                                   if tracked else ev.get("usage"))
2627                         selection = self.model_selection if isinstance(self.model_selection, dict) else {}
2628                         estimate = estimate_list_price_usd(selection.get("model_served") or selection.get("model"), counts)
2629                         if estimate is not None:
2630                             self.estimated_spend += estimate
2631                             self.estimated_turns += 1
2632                 else:
2633                     self.spend += cost
2634                 self.turns += 1
2635             # Checkpoint credit and final money/turn counts are persisted as
2636             # one state update. A restart must not see a final reservation
2637             # without its financial totals, or credit a completed turn again.
2638             saved, warning = self._persist_usage_locked()
2639         self._warn_usage_persistence(warning)
2640         if attribution_warning:
2641             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Usage could not be attributed to this session. The response is available, but its token and cost totals were not added."})
2642         return {"cost": cost, "duration": duration, "turn_tokens": turn_tokens,
2643                 "usage_persisted": saved, "accounted": not refused}
2644 
2645     def _attribution_ids(self):
2646         """``(project_id, folder_path)`` of the registered project this effort dir
2647         belongs to — the ids the cockpit already uses. A hit is cached for the
2648         engine's life; a miss is retried (a project may be registered later)."""
2649         if self._project_ids is None:
2650             try:
2651                 import usage_capture as _uc
2652                 ids = _uc.resolve_project(self.dir)
2653             except Exception:
2654                 ids = (None, None)
2655             if ids[0]:
2656                 self._project_ids = ids
2657             return ids
2658         return self._project_ids

2660     def _ledger_turn(self, ev, accounting, turn_id):
2661         """Wave 2 S1: one write-once ledger row per finalized turn, stamped with
2662         the ids that flow back to the project (project_id, folder_path, this
2663         effort dir, the engine session, the provider's invocation id or the
2664         cockpit turn id). An unpriced turn keeps cost ``None``. Best-effort."""
2665         if (not isinstance(accounting, dict) or not accounting.get("accounted")
2666                 or not self.session_id):
2667             return
2668         try:
2669             import usage_capture as _uc
2670             # the provider's invocation id, else cli:session:turn — no boot epoch,
2671             # so the same turn keys the same row across a restart (Grok R1 F6)
2672             native = (_usage_uuid(ev.get("usage_invocation_id"))
2673                       or f"{self.cli}:{self.session_id}:{self.turns}")
2674             project_id, folder_path = self._attribution_ids()
2675             served = (self.model_selection.get("model_served")
2676                       if isinstance(self.model_selection, dict) else None)
2677             usage = ev.get("usage") if isinstance(ev.get("usage"), dict) else None
2678             _uc.ingest_usage(
2679                 self.session_id, _uc.turn_key(self.session_id, native),
2680                 source=_uc.SOURCE_TERMINAL_TURN if self.general else _uc.SOURCE_STEWARD_TURN,
2681                 native_id=native, tokens=accounting.get("turn_tokens") or 0,
2682                 cost_usd=accounting.get("cost"), project_id=project_id,
2683                 folder_path=folder_path, effort_dir=self.dir, cli=self.cli,
2684                 model=served, duration_ms=int((accounting.get("duration") or 0) * 1000),
2685                 usage=usage, provider_connection_id=self.provider_connection["id"])
2686         except Exception:
2687             pass
2688         self._ledger_children()

2690     def _spawn_env(self):
2691         """The steward process's environment: the model policy plus the ids its
2692         children inherit (project, this effort dir, where to drop receipts)."""
2693         import model_policy
2694         env = model_policy.policy_environment()
2695         import provider_native
2696         _account_env = provider_native.account_env(self.provider_connection)
2697         for _key in ("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", "CODEX_HOME", "ANCHOR_PROVIDER_CONNECTION"):
2698             if _key in _account_env:
2699                 env[_key] = _account_env[_key]
2700         # A1 (delegated-work PROPOSAL v0.3; Grok code R1 F1-F3, R2 N1-N2): every git ANY agent session runs - steward,
2701         # code job or workbench terminal - goes through gitguard, which refuses tree-rewriting verbs outside a code
2702         # job's own worktree BEFORE git runs: a real git.exe (found for `git` and `git.exe` alike), a `git` script and
2703         # BASH_ENV for Git Bash; the plain git.cmd directory only if the launcher could not be built.
2704         try:
2705             import shutil, sys as _sys
2706             from steward_cockpit import code_jobs as _cj
2707             tools_guard = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "tools" / "gitguard")
2708             try:
2709                 import importlib.util as _ilu
2710                 _spec = _ilu.spec_from_file_location("anchor_gitguard_install", os.path.join(tools_guard, "install.py"))
2711                 _ggi = _ilu.module_from_spec(_spec)
2712                 _spec.loader.exec_module(_ggi)
2713                 bin_dir, bash_env = _ggi.ensure()
2714             except Exception:
2715                 bin_dir, bash_env = "", ""
2716             guard = bin_dir or tools_guard
2717             path_now = env.get("PATH") or os.environ.get("PATH", "")
2718             skip = {os.path.normcase(p.rstrip("\\/")) for p in (bin_dir, tools_guard) if p}
2719             real = env.get("GITGUARD_REAL_GIT") or shutil.which("git", path=os.pathsep.join(
2720                 p for p in path_now.split(os.pathsep) if os.path.normcase(p.rstrip("\\/")) not in skip))
2721             if real and os.path.isdir(guard):
2722                 env["GITGUARD_REAL_GIT"] = real
2723                 env["GITGUARD_PYTHON"] = _sys.executable
2724                 env["GITGUARD_ALLOW_UNDER"] = str(_cj.jobs_base())
2725                 env["PATH"] = guard + os.pathsep + path_now
2726                 if bash_env:
2727                     env["BASH_ENV"] = bash_env
2728         except Exception:
2729             pass
2730         try:
2731             import usage_capture as _uc
2732             project_id, folder_path = self._attribution_ids()
2733             env.update(_uc.attribution_env(project_id=project_id, effort_dir=self.dir,
2734                                            folder_path=folder_path, session_id=self.session_id))
2735         except Exception:
2736             pass
2737         return env
2738 
2739     def _ledger_children(self, session_id=None):
2740         """S2: one row per child this session spawned (Codex thread children by
2741         root session, Claude agent transcripts), under this effort, beside the
2742         steward's own figure. ``session_id`` names a stored session at engine
2743         start (a resumed Claude steward binds its own only at its first native
2744         event — Grok S2 F8). Best-effort."""
2745         session_id = session_id or self.session_id
2746         if not session_id:
2747             return
2748         try:
2749             import usage_capture as _uc

2757     def _ack_submitted(self, proc, ev):
2758         """Wave 1.2 acknowledgement: a native event for this turn means the
2759         provider has the message; the durable copy is no longer needed.
2760         Under the ingress lock with a proc re-check (Grok R1 F2/F6): an old
2761         reader must never clear a NEWER turn's copy or touch the queue while
2762         say() mutates it. Returns True when it acknowledged something."""
2763         with self._lock:
2764             if proc is not self.proc or self._submitted is None:
2765                 return False
2766             if ev.get("type") == "result" and ev.get("is_error") and ev.get("replay_safe") is True:
2767                 # never submitted natively: give it back to the queue as-is
2768                 pending = self._submitted.get("text") or ""
2769                 if pending and pending not in self.queue:
2770                     self.queue.insert(0, pending)
2771                     self._persist_queue()
2772                     self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "the turn failed before your message reached the model; it is queued again"})
2773             self._submitted = None
2774             _update_state(self.skey(), {"submitted": None})
2775             return True
2776 
2777     def _handle(self, ev, proc):
2778         if proc is not self.proc:
2779             return   # event from a superseded process - drop it entirely
2780         t = ev.get("type")
2781         if self._submitted is not None and t in ("assistant", "stream_event", "result"):
2782             self._ack_submitted(proc, ev)
2783         if t == "system" and ev.get("subtype") == "init":
2784             if proc is not self.proc:
2785                 return
2786             if not self._retain_native_session(_read_state_entry(self.skey())):
2787                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Native session history could not be preserved; retaining the prior pointer"})
2788                 self.broken = True
2789                 return
2790             self.session_id = ev.get("session_id")
2791             # init.model is configuration, not proof of what actually served.
2792             _update_state(self.skey(), {"session_id": self.session_id, "cli": self.cli,
2793                                       "model_policy": self.model_selection})
2794         elif t == "usage_checkpoint":
2795             self._record_usage_checkpoint(ev)
2796         elif t == "stream_event":
2797             inner = ev.get("event", {})
2798             if inner.get("type") == "content_block_delta":
2799                 delta = inner.get("delta", {})
2800                 if delta.get("type") == "text_delta":
2801                     self.last_output = time.time()
2802                     _tm = getattr(self, "_timing", None)
2803                     if _tm is not None and _tm.get("first_word") is None:
2804                         _tm["first_word"] = self.last_output
2805                     self.turn_text += delta.get("text", "")
2806                     self._emit({"t": "delta", "text": delta.get("text", ""),
2807                                 "tick": self.in_tick})
2808         elif t == "assistant":
2809             # tool activity is liveness too - keep the "stuck" light honest
2810             # through a long tool-only turn (a Foreman/researchPrime wave)
2811             self.last_output = time.time()
2812             for block in ev.get("message", {}).get("content", []):
2813                 if block.get("type") == "tool_use":
2814                     self._turn_had_tools = True
2815                     self._turn_tools = getattr(self, "_turn_tools", 0) + 1
2816                     if self._guard_turn(block):
2817                         return
2818                     inp = block.get("input") or {}
2819                     fp = inp.get("file_path")
2820                     # a Claude edit names one file_path; a Codex file_change names its paths
2821                     touched = [p for p in (inp.get("paths") or []) if isinstance(p, str) and p.strip()] \
2822                         if isinstance(inp.get("paths"), list) else []
2823                     if isinstance(fp, str) and fp.strip():
2824                         touched.insert(0, fp)
2825                     if block.get("name") in ("Write", "Edit", "NotebookEdit", "file_change"):
2826                         self._turn_wrote_files = True
2827                         refs = getattr(self, "_turn_output_refs", [])
2828                         for path in touched:
2829                             if path not in refs:
2830                                 refs.append(path)
2831                         self._turn_output_refs = refs
2832                         new = [p for p in touched if p not in self.files]
2833                         if new:
2834                             self.files.extend(new)
2835                             _update_state(self.skey(), {"files": self.files[-40:]})
2836                     if getattr(self, "_timing", None) is not None:
2837                         self._timing["tools"] = self._timing.get("tools", 0) + 1
2838                     self._emit({"t": "tool",
2839                                 "name": block.get("name", "?"),
2840                                 "detail": _tool_detail(block),
2841                                 "tick": self.in_tick})
2842         elif t == "result":
2843             if not self._usage_result_allowed(ev):
2844                 return
2845             if proc is not self.proc:
2846                 return   # re-check: a newer process must own this result
2847             # (2026-09-04, John) a model session limit is TOLD, never swallowed:
2848             # an error result is said in the pane with its text, a limit raises
2849             # the flag so the High Seat says "need you" with the reason.
2850             err_text = result_error_text(ev)
2851             if self.model_selection:
2852                 actual = ev.get("model_served") if ev.get("model_attested") is True else None
2853                 source = ev.get("model_source") if isinstance(ev.get("model_source"), str) else None
2854                 if self.cli == "claude" and not err_text:
2855                     usage_models = ev.get("modelUsage")

2857                         actual, source = next(iter(usage_models)), "cli-recorded"
2858                 requested = self.model_selection.get("model")
2859                 self.model_selection = {**self.model_selection, "model_served": actual,
2860                                         "model_attested": bool(actual),
2861                                         "model_source": source if actual else None}
2862                 _update_state(self.skey(), {"model_policy": self.model_selection})
2863                 if actual and requested and not _same_model(requested, actual):
2864                     self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": f"model served {actual} (requested {requested})"})
2865             if not err_text:
2866                 self._journal_changed_receipt()
2867             if err_text:
2868                 limit = _campaign_limit(err_text)

2870                 self._journal_receipt("turn_error", err_text)
2871                 hint = ev.get("stderr_hint")

2873                 if isinstance(hint, dict) and hint.get("kinds"):
2874                     tail_text = (" | native diagnostics: " + ", ".join(str(k) for k in hint["kinds"][:4])
2875                                  + f" ({int(hint.get('lines') or 0)} lines, content withheld)")

2877                                                  "the steward's turn ended in an error: ")

2887             accounting = self._record_usage_result(ev)

3077     def _maybe_drive(self, was_tick=False):
3078         """Compatibility wrapper for tests/callers outside turn arbitration."""

3080             return self._maybe_drive_locked(was_tick, self.turn_text.strip())

3082     def _retry_refinement_handoffs(self):
3083         """Drain one saved observation through the existing ledger, never under the stdin lock."""
3084         if not getattr(self, "_pending_refinement_handoffs", {}):
3085             return True
3086         if not self._refinement_retry_lock.acquire(blocking=False):
3087             return False
3088         try:
3089             with self._refinement_pending_lock:
3090                 if not self._pending_refinement_handoffs:
3091                     return True
3092                 producer_id, payload = next(iter(self._pending_refinement_handoffs.items()))
3093                 # A failed session-state write must not silently orphan an observation.
3094                 if not _update_state(self.skey(), {
3095                         "pending_refinement_handoffs": self._pending_refinement_handoffs}):
3096                     return False
3097             from steward_cockpit.producer_handoff import record_handoff
3098             try:
3099                 receipt = record_handoff(self.dir, **payload)
3100             except Exception as exc:
3101                 receipt = {"ok": False, "error": "handoff-recording-failed",
3102                            "detail": type(exc).__name__}
3103             with self._refinement_pending_lock:
3104                 remaining = dict(self._pending_refinement_handoffs)
3105                 if receipt.get("ok"):
3106                     remaining.pop(producer_id, None)
3107                 acknowledged = _update_state(self.skey(), {
3108                     "pending_refinement_handoffs": remaining,
3109                     "refinement_handoff": receipt})
3110                 if acknowledged:
3111                     self._pending_refinement_handoffs = remaining
3112             error = (receipt.get("error") if not receipt.get("ok") else
3113                      "handoff-receipt-persistence-failed" if not acknowledged else None)
3114             if error and error != self._refinement_handoff_error:
3115                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "Work completed, but its refinement handoff needs repair: " + str(error)})
3116             self._refinement_handoff_error = error
3117             return bool(receipt.get("ok") and acknowledged)
3118         finally:
3119             self._refinement_retry_lock.release()
3120 
3121     def _maybe_drive_locked(self, was_tick=False, completed_text=""):
3122         """Choose and send one drive continuation while holding ``_lock``.
3123 
3124         Human ingress, queued text, nudges, and drive all share this arbiter;
3125         drive must never stack onto an already accepted turn.
3126         """
3127         if (self.busy or self.queue or not self.drive or not self.alive()
3128                 or getattr(self, "_pending_refinement_handoffs", {})):
3129             return
3130         from steward_cockpit import maintenance
3131         if maintenance.is_active():
3132             return  # Wave 1.6: no self-started turn behind the barrier
3133         if was_tick:
3134             return   # a cadence-tick turn is not a step - never counts as drive
3135         txt = (completed_text or "").strip()
3136         try:
3137             from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as campaign
3138             attention = campaign.read_map(self.dir)["attention"]
3139         except Exception:
3140             attention = {"state": "unknown"}
3141         if attention.get("managed_refinement"):
3142             if (self._question_contexts(attention) or attention.get("producer_recovery_required")
3143                     or attention.get("state") == "unknown"):
3144                 return
3145         elif self.open_question or txt.endswith("?"):
3146             return
3147         att = attention.get("state")
3148         # drive housekeeping lines are status-pane traffic, not conversation
3149         # (handoff 2026-08-25 #4 — CLI declutter): the tick tag routes them
3150         if att == "needs_you":
3151             self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
3152                         "text": "drive: campaign flag says needs-you - waiting"})
3153             return
3154         if self.auto_count >= self.DRIVE_CAP:
3155             self.drive = False
3156             self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
3157                         "text": f"drive: cap reached ({self.DRIVE_CAP} continues) - pausing; say go to re-arm"})
3158             return
3159         self.auto_count += 1
3160         self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
3161                     "text": f"drive: continuing ({self.auto_count})"})
3162         self._send_locked(
3163             "(drive - not John) Continue. Next step per the plan; stop only "
3164             "for a decision that is genuinely John's, and if you stop, end "
3165             "with the question.")
3166

3173             from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as campaign
3174             return campaign.read_map(self.dir).get("attention", {})
3175         except Exception:
3176             return {"state": "unknown", "reason": "Work status unavailable"}

3178     def _early_receipt(self, started):
3179         """Two-lane step 1 (2026-10-05, Opus: 'words within a minute' needs words he can see before the model's own,
3180         which ChatGPT only sends at the end of a turn): 20 s into a turn on his message with nothing said yet, the
3181         engine says what the steward is on. Once per turn; never on a turn that has spoken or ended."""
3182         try:
3183             tm = getattr(self, "_timing", None) or {}
3184             if not self.busy or self.turn_started != started or tm.get("first_word") or (self.turn_text or "").strip():
3185                 return
3186             self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "%s is on it \u2014 %s (%d s so far)" % (
3187                 self.steward or "The steward", self._turn_activity(), int(time.time() - started)), "receipt": True})
3188         except Exception:
3189             pass

3191     def _record_timing(self, duration, was_tick):
3192         """W1 of the two-lane plan (2026-10-05): one line per turn in <effort>/.ecgberht/turn-timing.jsonl - how long his
3193         message waited, how long to the first word, the whole turn, the tools. Never raises; the measurement never costs
3194         a turn."""
3195         tm = getattr(self, "_timing", None) or {}
3196         self._timing = None
3197         try:
3198             started = float(tm.get("started") or 0)
3199             if not started:
3200                 return
3201             row = {"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "origin": "tick" if was_tick else getattr(self, "_turn_origin", ""),
3202                    "cli": self.cli, "effort": (self.model_selection or {}).get("effort"),
3203                    "queued_s": round(started - tm["arrived"], 1) if tm.get("arrived") else None,
3204                    "first_word_s": round(tm["first_word"] - started, 1) if tm.get("first_word") else None,
3205                    "turn_s": round(float(duration or 0), 1), "tools": int(tm.get("tools") or 0)}
3206             p = Path(self.dir) / ".ecgberht" / "turn-timing.jsonl"
3207             p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3208             with open(p, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
3209                 f.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")

3213     def _working_bg(self):
3214         """True when the campaign flag says commissioned/background work is
3215         in flight — disk truth, zero-model. The steward's own turn may be
3216         idle while a commissioned run (Gandalf, Foreman) works; the old
3217         busy-only cadence showed NOTHING for exactly the long work John
3218         wants to watch (handoff 2026-08-25 #2a)."""
3219         if self._attention().get("state") == "working":
3220             return True
3221         try:   # 2026-10-05: a running code job is background work the cadence must narrate
3222             from steward_cockpit.steward_campaign import running_code_jobs
3223             return bool(running_code_jobs(self.dir))

3225             return False

3227     def _status_update(self, emit=True):
3228         """The 10-minute status OF RECORD — deterministic, two-part,
3229         zero-model (the audit's 'status treatment A' grown to commissioned
3230         runs). TOP: what is running now. BOTTOM: where the whole plan
3231         stands. Persisted to <cdir>/.ecgberht/status-summary.json — the
3232         UNIVERSAL file both the cockpit's right pane and the main-dashboard
3233         project tile read — and (emit=True) sent as a 'status' event the
3234         client routes to the status pane only, never the conversation."""
3235         if self.general:
3236             return False
3237         # Compose, persist, and emit one generation under one lock. A ticker
3238         # and a result boundary can request status concurrently; neither may
3239         # overwrite or replay an older truth after the newer one.
3240         with self._status_lock:
3241             try:
3242                 from steward_cockpit import steward_campaign as campaign
3243                 status = campaign.compose_status(self.dir, self.state())
3244             except Exception as exc:
3245                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
3246                             "text": "status compose failed: "
3247                                     + type(exc).__name__})
3248                 return False
3249             # (2026-09-04, John) a commissioned run that STOPPED — a model
3250             # session limit above all — must reach him, never just stop: flip a
3251             # flag still saying "working" to needs_you with the run's reason,
3252             # so the High Seat and the rail say "need you", and say it once here.
3253             try:
3254                 flipped = campaign.raise_halt_attention(self.dir, status)
3255                 if flipped:
3256                     self._emit({"t": "sys", "text": "STOPPED: " + flipped["reason"]})
3257                     status = campaign.compose_status(self.dir, self.state())
3258             except Exception:
3259                 pass
3260 
3261             persisted = False
3262             tmp = None
3263             try:
3264                 f = Path(self.dir) / ".ecgberht" / "status-summary.json"
3265                 f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3266                 tmp = f.with_name(
3267                     f.name + ".%s.%s.tmp" %
3268                     (os.getpid(), threading.get_ident()))
3269                 tmp.write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + "\n",
3270                                encoding="utf-8")
3271                 os.replace(tmp, f)
3272                 persisted = True
3273             except Exception as exc:
3274                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
3275                             "text": "status persistence failed: "
3276                                     + type(exc).__name__})
3277             finally:
3278                 if tmp is not None:
3279                     try:
3280                         tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
3281                     except Exception:
3282                         pass
3283 
3284             # Notification-budget counter (2026-08-25 elegance S-batch, B6
3285             # bar): count each transition INTO needs_you per local day.
3286             try:
3287                 cur = str(((status.get("plan") or {}).get("attention")) or "")
3288                 prev = getattr(self, "_last_attention_state", None)
3289                 self._last_attention_state = cur
3290                 if cur == "needs_you" and prev not in (None, "needs_you"):
3291                     self._delivery_patch(lambda d: d.update(
3292                         pings={"date": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
3293                                "count": (
3294                                    d.get("pings", {}).get("count", 0) + 1
3295                                    if d.get("pings", {}).get("date")
3296                                    == time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") else 1)}))
3297             except Exception:
3298                 pass
3299             if emit:
3300                 self._emit({"t": "status", "status": status})
3301             return persisted
3302 
3303     # ---------- delivery receipts (2026-08-25 elegance S-batch) ----------
3304     #: One lock for ALL delivery.json RMWs (review finding #3: concurrent acks +
3305     #: the ping counter raced an unlocked read-modify-write and lost updates).
3306     _DELIVERY_LOCK = threading.Lock()
3307 
3308     def _delivery_patch(self, mutate):
3309         """Atomically read-modify-write <cdir>/.ecgberht/delivery.json —
3310         locked, with _save_state's WinError-32 retry (a concurrent reader
3311         holding the file must delay, never drop, the write)."""
3312         # NOTE 2026-08-26: this said ``StewardEngine._DELIVERY_LOCK``. The class
3313         # is ``Engine`` — so EVERY call raised NameError, swallowed by the
3314         # callers' except-blocks: channel_verified never flipped and the ping
3315         # counter never counted from the moment the lock was introduced. The
3316         # receipt mechanism was reporting success while writing nothing.
3317         with Engine._DELIVERY_LOCK:
3318             f = Path(self.dir) / ".ecgberht" / "delivery.json"
3319             f.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
3320             try:
3321                 d = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
3322             except Exception:
3323                 d = {}
3324             mutate(d)
3325             tmp = f.with_suffix(f".tmp-{os.getpid()}")
3326             tmp.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
3327             for _attempt in range(6):
3328                 try:
3329                     os.replace(tmp, f)
3330                     return d
3331                 except PermissionError:
3332                     time.sleep(0.05)
3333             f.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
3334             return d
3335 
3336     def record_status_ack(self, at=""):
3337         """The wakeup-delivery lesson, mechanized: the pane POSTs an ack AFTER
3338         it RENDERS a status, so delivery is a receipt, not a hope. The first
3339         ack ever flips channel_verified — the one-time 'this channel reaches
3340         John' acknowledgment; every ack updates the render-leg log."""
3341         try:
3342             now = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
3343             state = {"first": False}
3344             def _mut(d):
3345                 state["first"] = not d.get("channel_verified")
3346                 d["channel_verified"] = True
3347                 if state["first"]:
3348                     d["channel_verified_at"] = now
3349                 d["last_render_ack_at"] = now
3350                 d["last_acked_status_at"] = str(at or "")
3351                 d["render_acks"] = int(d.get("render_acks", 0)) + 1
3352             self._delivery_patch(_mut)
3353             return {"ok": True, "channel_verified_first_time": state["first"]}
3354         except Exception as e:
3355             return {"ok": False, "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"}

3357     def _idle_tick(self, now):
3358         """Automatic sleep: quiet (no talk, no work, nothing queued) for
3359         IDLE_SLEEP_SECONDS -> park the process; resume is seamless. A
3360         commissioned/background run COUNTS AS WORK: the engine stays awake so
3361         the 10-minute status keeps flowing while it runs. The Campaign's own
3362         steward (W5, 2026-10-01: one conversation) takes the same checkpoint
3363         once per quiet spell and stays awake. True = parked."""
3364         quiet_since = max(self.last_say, self.last_output, self.woke_at)
3365         if (self.busy or self.queue or now - quiet_since <= IDLE_SLEEP_SECONDS
3366                 or self._working_bg()):
3367             return False
3368         if self.one_conversation and self._idle_marked == quiet_since:
3369             return False
3370         # commit-on-idle-close is a real mechanism, not a prompt
3371         self._commit_if_dirty("steward idle checkpoint" if self.one_conversation
3372                               else "steward auto-sleep checkpoint")
3373         if self.one_conversation:
3374             # it stays up: no leave receipt against an open conversation (Grok
3375             # W5) - the explicit project switch remains the leave
3376             self._idle_marked = quiet_since
3377             return False
3378         # W0 of the steward revision (2026-09-28): the FALLBACK leave receipt — only when
3379         # presence still says he is on this project (he never switched away); the explicit
3380         # switch on the High Seat or another cockpit is the trigger, this is the safety net.
3381         try:
3382             from . import presence as _pres
3383             _pres.leave_if_still_here(
3384                 self.dir, lambda _pid, at: _pres.run_leave(self.dir, at))
3385         except Exception:
3386             pass
3387         self._emit({"t": "sys", "text":
3388                     f"steward asleep after {IDLE_SLEEP_SECONDS // 60} "
3389                     "quiet minutes - everything saved; your next message wakes it"})
3390         self.stop()
3391         return True

3393     def _ticker(self, proc):
3394         while proc is self.proc and proc.poll() is None:
3395             time.sleep(TICK_CHECK)
3396             if proc is not self.proc:   # superseded by a newer process
3397                 return
3398             now = time.time()
3399             if not self.busy and self._pending_refinement_handoffs:
3400                 if self._retry_refinement_handoffs():
3401                     with self._lock:
3402                         self._maybe_drive_locked()
3403             if self._idle_tick(now):
3404                 return
3405             # THE DETERMINISTIC STATUS CADENCE (handoff 2026-08-25 #2): fires
3406             # during the steward's OWN busy turn AND during commissioned/
3407             # background work — the case the old busy-only trigger missed.
3408             # Zero-model; pane + universal file, never the conversation.
3409             if (not self.general and now - self.last_status > TICK_SECONDS
3410                     and (self.busy or self.queue or self._working_bg())):
3411                 self.last_status = now
3412                 self._status_update()
3413             # the model-facing cadence nudge (commit + HOLD; the status-table
3414             # demand is gone — the engine composes the status now)
3415             if (self.busy
3416                     and now - self.last_output > TICK_SECONDS
3417                     and now - self.last_tick > TICK_SECONDS):
3418                 # Wave 1.2: nothing is written into a busy broker any more.
3419                 # Every TICK/REASSERT envelope queued in the pipe became an
3420                 # extra full turn after the running one (Codex r2 F2) and
3421                 # delayed John's next message again. The cadence commit below
3422                 # still keys off last_tick; the role re-assert moves to the
3423                 # resume prefix (Wave 2.1).
3424                 self.last_tick = now
3425             # commit-as-you-go IS a mechanism now: a dirty tree gets committed
3426             # on the cadence, independent of whether the model remembers
3427             if now - self.last_tick < 2:
3428                 self._commit_if_dirty("steward cadence checkpoint")
