3430     def _commit_if_dirty(self, message):
3431         """The campaign's own paths only; other staging untouched; announced only on git's word. Takes the
3432         repository's one commit lock (git_safety, Grok R2 G1) so it never lands inside a code job's land."""
3433         try:
3434             import git_safety as _gs
3435             _lock = _gs.repo_lock(_gs.toplevel(self.dir) or self.dir, wait_s=30, who="steward commit " + str(self.dir))
3436         except Exception:
3437             return None      # never commit without the lock (Grok code R1 F7)
3438         if getattr(self, "_stopped_mid_turn", False):
3439             return None      # Opus 2026-10-05: a turn stopped mid-work may have left a half-written file - no checkpoint until a turn ends cleanly
3440         with _lock as held:
3441             if not held:
3442                 return None      # a land holds the lock: the next cadence tick commits
3443             return self._commit_if_dirty_locked(message)
3444 
3445     def _checkpoint_paths(self):
3446         """What a steward checkpoint may commit: its own subtree when the cockpit is a folder inside a repository; only
3447         the steward's bookkeeping when the cockpit folder IS the repository root (e.g. the Anchor project's cockpit at
3448         C:\\dev\\Anchor), so a checkpoint never sweeps other sessions' files (Grok code R1 F8)."""
3449         try:
3450             import git_safety as _gs
3451             root = _gs.toplevel(self.dir)
3452         except Exception:
3453             root = ""
3454         if root and root != os.path.normcase(str(Path(self.dir).resolve())):
3455             return ["."]
3456         keep = ["ECGBERHT.md", "roadmap.json", "strip.json", "DELIVERABLES.md", "journal", ".ecgberht"]
3457         return [k for k in keep if (Path(self.dir) / k).exists()] or ["ECGBERHT.md"]
3458 
3459     def _commit_if_dirty_locked(self, message):
3460         if self.fake:
3461             return
3462         try:
3463             dirty = subprocess.run(
3464                 ["git", "status", "--porcelain", "--", *self._checkpoint_paths()], cwd=self.dir,
3465                 capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
3466             if dirty.returncode != 0 or not dirty.stdout.strip():
3467                 return
3468             add = subprocess.run(["git", "add", "-A", "--", *self._checkpoint_paths()], cwd=self.dir,
3469                                  capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
3470             commit = (subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", message, "--", *self._checkpoint_paths()], cwd=self.dir,
3471                                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
3472                       if add.returncode == 0 else add)
3473             if commit.returncode == 0:
3474                 # cadence housekeeping → the status pane, not the conversation
3475                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
3476                             "text": "committed work-in-progress (cadence)"})
3477             else:
3478                 tail = (commit.stderr or commit.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()
3479                 self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True,
3480                             "text": "commit failed: " + (tail[-1] if tail else f"git exit {commit.returncode}")})
3481         except Exception as exc:
3482             self._emit({"t": "sys", "tick": True, "text": "commit failed: " + str(exc)})
3483

3497     def _journal_changed_receipt(self):
3498         """At turn end: the steward's newest journal entry gets one receipt
3499         (the strip's last journal receipt says whether it already has one)."""
3500         try:
3501             base = Path(self.dir)
3502             newest, newest_m = None, 0.0
3503             for rel in ("journal", ".ecgberht/journal"):
3504                 d = base / rel
3505                 if d.is_dir():
3506                     for p in d.glob("*.md"):
3507                         m = p.stat().st_mtime
3508                         if m > newest_m:
3509                             newest, newest_m = p, m
3510             if newest is None:
3511                 return
3512             if any(isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("entry_id") == newest.stem
3513                    for r in self._read_strip().get("receipts") or []):
3514                 return                                   # already receipted
3515             first = ""
3516             with io.open(newest, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
3517                 for line in fh:
3518                     if line.strip():
3519                         first = line.strip().lstrip("# ").strip()
3520                         break
3521             self._strip_receipt({"kind": "journal_update", "path": newest.relative_to(base).as_posix(),
3522                                  "entry_id": newest.stem, "summary": first[:300] or newest.stem})
3523         except Exception:
3524             pass

3526     def proceed_on_silence(self, question_id, now=None):
3527         """A reversible decision with an undo and a recommendation proceeds on that recommendation
3528         after SILENCE_SECONDS of John's silence: the steward is told first (a failed tell is retried
3529         by the next tick), then the decision is recorded as proceeded on silence - never as his
3530         words - and the wait on him cleared. A review request (the ledger's) never proceeds so."""
3531         now = time.time() if now is None else now
3532         with self._lock:
3533             q = next((c for c in self._question_contexts(self._attention()) if c.get("id") == question_id), None)
3534             if not q or q.get("reversible") is not True or not q.get("undo") or not q.get("recommendation"):
3535                 return {"ok": False, "reason": "not a reversible decision with an undo and a recommendation"}
3536             if (q.get("authorization_scope") or {}).get("request_id"):
3537                 return {"ok": False, "reason": "a review request waits for John"}
3538             asked = q.get("asked_at")
3539             if not isinstance(asked, (int, float)) or isinstance(asked, bool) or now - asked < SILENCE_SECONDS:
3540                 return {"ok": False, "reason": "not yet"}
3541             if any((e.get("question") or {}).get("id") == question_id for e in self.question_history):
3542                 return {"ok": False, "reason": "already decided"}
3543         line = ("Proceeded on silence: John did not answer within %d hours and the decision was reversible, "
3544                 "so the recommendation stands - %s Undo: %s") % (SILENCE_SECONDS // 3600, q["recommendation"], q["undo"])
3545         told = self.say(line, human=False)
3546         if not told.get("ok"):
3547             return {"ok": False, "reason": told.get("error") or "the steward could not be told"}
3548         with self._lock:
3549             entry = {"question": q, "answer": q["recommendation"], "answered_at": now,
3550                      "status": "proceeded_on_silence", "source_ref": "silence"}
3551             history = (list(self.question_history) + [entry])[-100:]
3552             if not _update_state(self.skey(), {"question_history": history, "open_question": "",
3553                                                "open_question_kind": "", "question_context": None}):
3554                 return {"ok": False, "reason": "state not saved"}
3555             self.question_history = history
3556             self.open_question, self.open_question_kind, self.question_context = "", "", None
3557             self._answer_nudged = self._decision_nudged = False
3558             self._strip_clear_wait()
3559         return {"ok": True, "reason": ""}
3560 
3561     def _answered_before(self, question, step_id):
3562         """The history entry that already answered this very question on this
3563         step, else None."""
3564         for entry in reversed(getattr(self, "question_history", None) or []):
3565             saved = entry.get("question") if isinstance(entry, dict) else None
3566             if isinstance(saved, dict) and str(saved.get("question") or "").strip() == str(question or "").strip() \
3567                     and (saved.get("authorization_scope") or {}).get("step_id") == step_id:
3568                 return entry
3569         return None

3571     def _strip_clear_wait(self):
3572         """John answered a decision: the wait on him is over. The engine's one
3573         strip field, one atomic write under the process lock, never minting a
3574         strip that does not exist (a product review's wait is the ledger's)."""
3575         path = Path(self.dir) / "strip.json"
3576         with _paths.WRITE_LOCK:
3577             if not path.is_file():
3578                 return
3579             strip = self._read_strip()
3580             if not strip or not str(strip.get("human_wait") or "").strip():
3581                 return
3582             strip["human_wait"] = ""
3583             tmp = path.with_suffix(".json.engine.tmp")
3584             tmp.write_text(json.dumps(strip, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
3585             os.replace(tmp, path)

3587     def _read_strip(self):
3588         path = Path(self.dir) / "strip.json"
3589         try:
3590             strip = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.is_file() else {}
3591         except (OSError, ValueError):
3592             strip = {}
3593         return strip if isinstance(strip, dict) else {}

3595     def _strip_receipt(self, receipt):
3596         """Append one receipt to the campaign's strip.json (bounded to 60). The
3597         strip has one writer (the steward); the engine re-reads it at the moment
3598         of writing under the process lock and touches only ``receipts``, and
3599         never mints a strip that does not exist."""
3600         path = Path(self.dir) / "strip.json"
3601         with _paths.WRITE_LOCK:
3602             if not path.is_file():
3603                 return
3604             strip = self._read_strip()
3605             if not strip:
3606                 return
3607             receipts = strip.get("receipts") if isinstance(strip.get("receipts"), list) else []
3608             receipts.append({"at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()), "source": "engine",
3609                              "step_id": strip.get("current_step_id"), "session_id": self.session_id, **receipt})
3610             strip["receipts"] = receipts[-60:]
3611             tmp = path.with_suffix(".json.engine.tmp")
3612             tmp.write_text(json.dumps(strip, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
3613             os.replace(tmp, path)

3620 _DRIVE_OFFER_RE = re.compile(
3621     r"^(?:shall i drive|shall i keep going|should i keep going|"
3622     r"do you want me to (?:drive|keep going)|"
3623     r"would you like me to (?:drive|keep going))\?$", re.I)
3624 
3625 
3626 def _question_kind(question) -> str:
3627     """Classify the pinned question without substring false positives.
3628 
3629     A drive offer is deliberately a tiny exact grammar. Substantive questions
3630     that merely contain words such as "continue" always remain decisions.
3631     """
3632     normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (question or "").strip())
3633     return "drive_offer" if _DRIVE_OFFER_RE.fullmatch(normalized) else "decision"
3634 
3635 
3636 _SNAPSHOT_SUFFIX = re.compile(r"^-(?:\d[\d-]*|build.*)$")
3637 
3638 
3639 def _same_model(requested, served):
3640     """The served id is the requested one, or the requested one plus a dated
3641     snapshot (``-2026-09-01``) or build suffix (``-build``); a sibling
3642     (``gpt-6-astra-mini``, ``gpt-5.4`` for ``gpt-5``) is a different model."""
3643     requested, served = str(requested or ""), str(served or "")
3644     if not requested or not served:
3645         return True
3646     if served == requested:
3647         return True
3648     return served.startswith(requested) and bool(_SNAPSHOT_SUFFIX.match(served[len(requested):]))

3651 def _tool_detail(block):
3652     inp = block.get("input") or {}
3653     name = block.get("name", "")
3654     for key in ("skill", "command", "description", "file_path", "prompt",
3655                 "pattern", "query"):
3656         if key in inp and isinstance(inp[key], str):
3657             text = inp[key].replace("\n", " ")
3658             return text[:90] + ("..." if len(text) > 90 else "")
3659     if isinstance(inp.get("paths"), list) and inp["paths"]:
3660         text = ", ".join(str(p) for p in inp["paths"][:6])
3661         return text[:90] + ("..." if len(text) > 90 else "")
3662     return ""
